\section{Background}

AlphaSuite measures the functional correctness of programs generated from comments, and sampling 50 programs per problem solves 47.25\% of its problems~\cite{Alpha2021}.
BetaBench contains prompts for 300 coding tasks that span nine programming models~\cite{Beta2024}.
GammaEval evaluates whether language models can write vector kernels that are both correct and faster than a reference library~\cite{Gamma2025}.
On a suite of 180 library workloads, current models match the reference library in fewer than 15\% of cases~\cite{Beta2024}.
